newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ebro, Azucarera merger seen 3:1 share exchange.
newsitem.headline: Ebro, Azucarera merger seen 3:1 share exchange.

text.p: Spanish sugar group Azucarera would exchange one of its own shares for three of fellow producer Ebro Agricolas in the event of a merger, broker Ibersecurities said on Monday.
The two companies announced on Friday they had agreed to start talks on a possible merger which would create the fifth largest sugar group in the European Union.
"In the likely case that these talks will result in a merger, the exchange would be one Azucarera share for three from Ebro," the broker said in a research note.
Ibersecurities said in the event of a merger, Saint-Louis' Generale Sucriere unit would try to maintain its 20.7 percent stake in Azucarera.

"Generale Sucriere has already made it known that it wants its presence in the merged company to be at least equal to the stake it currently holds in Azucarera and is also studying the possibility of increasing it to 24 percent," the note said.
It added that it had valued Ebro's shares at 2,671 pesetas and Azucarera's shares at 7,935 pesetas based on the companies' production quota and capacity to generate funds.
At 1430 GMT, Ebro were trading 130 pesetas higher at 1,980, while Azucarera had gained 170 pesetas to stand at 5,300.
